L01.smt: (define-fun spec ((amount Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (and (>= amount 0) (<= amount max_rate)))

L02.smt: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (<= n max_rate))
L02.ambiguity: yes: 'max_rate / time_period' can be read as an arithmetic quotient or as 'max_rate per time_period'; taken as the latter, so max_rate acquisitions are allowed within one period

L03.smt: (define-fun spec ((limit Int) (used Int) (cost Int)) Bool (<= (+ used cost) limit))

L04.smt: (define-fun spec ((requested Int) (available Int)) Bool (<= requested available))

L05.smt: (define-fun spec ((k Int) (calls Int)) Bool (<= k calls))

L07.smt: (define-fun spec ((weight Int) (limit Int)) Bool (> weight limit))

L08.smt: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (limit Int)) Bool (<= n limit))

L09.smt: (define-fun spec ((existing Int) (amount Int) (limit Int)) Bool (<= (+ existing amount) limit))
L09.ambiguity: yes: unclear whether the compared count is the one already recorded (existing <= limit) or the count after adding this request (existing + amount <= limit); taken as the latter

L10.smt: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (capacity Int)) Bool (<= n capacity))
